skill.displayName: Pagrehistro ng PowPow — magrehistro ng Bula, i-pin ang talaarawan ng paglalakbay sa mapa, kausapin ang digital na tao

version.changelog: tl translation of powpow-register v2.0.1 (agent-assisted registration onboarding).

llm.summary: This is a coherent PowPow registration and subscription helper, but it handles account, payment, and login-session data that users should treat carefully.

dimensions.detail: Node execution, outbound network access, optional local avatar-file reading, temporary file creation, and browser opening are proportionate to an agent-assisted registration/payment flow, but they are sensitive enough to warrant user confirmation before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time script, dependency install, persistence hook, or background worker was found; the packaged Node script is zero-dependency and invoked only by runtime commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is strongly scoped in text and script to https://global.powpow.online, but it also instructs the agent to open a generated local payment HTML file with an OS opener and the listing metadata describes broader social/map experiences than the registration workflow itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script stores email, username, nickname, JWT token, order number, and flow state in a temp state file with 0600 mode and provides cleanup; no password is written to disk and no durable system persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the core purpose: introduce PowPow/Bula, collect user-approved registration details, send verification requests, upload an optional avatar, create an Alipay order, poll payment status, and generate official login links.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help create and activate a PowPow/Bula account. Expect your registration details, optional avatar, verification code, payment order details, and login tokens to be sent to PowPow and temporarily stored locally until cleanup. Confirm the subscription package before any payment page is opened, do not share generated login links, and run cleanup when finished.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced script was present locally and was fully inspected; it hardcodes the PowPow domain, has no dependencies, and contains no remote code retrieval, hidden persistence, or tool hijacking.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending email, username, optional avatar/phone, payment order metadata, and session tokens to PowPow is intrinsic to the stated registration and activation workflow and is disclosed, though users should understand this data leaves the chat environment.
[LP3] expected: The skill needs command execution, environment-variable password passing, and network access to the PowPow service; the lack of formal permission metadata is an audit gap, not evidence of hidden behavior in the artifact.
[SDI-2] expected: Opening the generated payment page with start/open/xdg-open is purpose-aligned for the Alipay checkout flow, but it should be treated as a sensitive local action and limited to the file path returned by the inspected script after the user chooses a package.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The listing keywords and display name mention map posting and digital-human experiences more broadly than the skill performs; the main skill text explicitly excludes posting or digital-human creation, so this is overbroad marketing rather than hidden functionality.
[SQP-3] expected: The artifact is a Tagalog-localized skill with mixed platform UI strings; this is a usability/localization limitation, not a security concern.
